blocks.text: You can customize page settings on the Resource Inventory, Data Inventory, Data Duplications, and Alerts pages to focus on the specific information you want to see. You can apply filters, show or hide the required columns and save this page setting for future use. This allows you to return to the same customized page view without having to reapply the settings each time you visit the page.

You can save multiple page views with unique names. You can also update an existing view and save it as a new page view. The customized page views are applicable for each individual user and other users cannot see them. The default page view cannot be changed or deleted.
To customize and save a page setting:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Data Inventory.
The Data Inventory page is used in this procedure. You can also customize the page settings on the Resource Inventory, Data Duplications, and Alerts pages.
Apply the filters, show or hide the columns, and sort the data on the page as required.
Click Default View in the top-right corner and select Save as New View.
In the Save View window, enter a name for the customized page setting.
To save this page setting as the default view every time you visit the page, select the Set as Default View checkbox.

blocks.text: To delete the saved page setting:

blocks.item: Click Default View in the top-right corner and click the Delete icon for the customized page view.
In the Delete View window, enter CONFIRM in the text box, then click Delete.
